new_reasoning.because: Qwen3.6-27B beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified at 40 tok/s on an RTX 3090, Ollama MLX hits 1.57x prefill and 1.93x decode on an M5 Max, and DeepSeek V4-Pro is roughly 28x cheaper than Opus 4.7.
new_reasoning.given: Quality, throughput and price all clear the proprietary-frontier-API bar at consumer-GPU and Apple-Silicon scale, and Anthropic's July 18 repricing supplied the cost shock meant to push developers local.
new_reasoning.so_that: Enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness - either the local-for-coding, remote-for-planning split, or the policy-routed gateway that already spans open-weight, self-hosted and frontier endpoints.
new_reasoning.landing: By Q3 2026; the gateway shape exists at scale but routes on cost and governance rather than task type, and no Big-3 IDE has shipped a local-first default with about ten weeks left.
new_reasoning.plain_language: Cheap local coding models keep improving, but the big hybrid setups route by cost and policy rather than by task, and no major editor defaults to local yet.

reason: Applied the 2026-07-19 stale judgement. Bridge validation.3cab277c2cb7cb4c (2026-07-18) records the largest real-world instance of the hybrid harness arriving on a different axis than the old so_that specified: Anaconda's acquisition of Kilo Code, a gateway routing close to 10 trillion tokens a month for 3 million developers across 500-plus open-weight, self-hosted and frontier-cloud endpoints, where routing is driven by cost and governance policy rather than by task type. The bridge states that the measurement runs against the thesis. Because and given remain factually intact and the Q3 2026 window is still open, so this is a reframing rather than a falsification: so_that now absorbs the policy-routed-gateway variant alongside the task-type split, given records the cost shock the thesis predicted actually arriving, and landing states plainly that the Big-3 IDE local-first-default condition still has no supporting evidence.
